title: The affine etale site of a limit of schemes is the colimit of the affine etale sites

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EYL (lemma-colimit-affine-sites, line 7336) and its proof, which uses Limits Lemmas Tag 01ZM (descend-finite-presentation), Tag 01Z6 (limit-affine), Tag 07RP (descend-etale), Tag 07RR (descend-surjective), Tag 0EY1 (descend-finite-presentation-variant); the colimit of sites is Sites Lemma Tag 09YL

proof.text: *Step 1 (the schemes involved; the functors are well defined).* Each $f_i$ is affine [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition], hence quasi-compact and separated [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence](3); as $X_i$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, so is $X$ [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](2). Let $T$ be one of the quasi-separated schemes $X$, $X_i$ and $U\to T$ an object of $T_{affine,\Et}$: it is etale, hence locally of finite presentation [def-weil-etale-morphism], and $U$ is affine, so $U\to T$ is of finite presentation [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](1) ("any object of $X_{affine,\Et}$, resp. $(X_i)_{affine,\Et}$, is of finite presentation over $X$, resp. $X_i$"). Let $h:T'\to T$ be one of the affine morphisms $f_{i'i}$ ($T=X_i$, $T'=X_{i'}$) or $f_i$ ($T=X_i$, $T'=X$) and $V$ an object of $T_{affine,\Et}$. The projection $V\times_TT'\to V$ is a base change of $h$, hence affine, so $V\times_TT'$ is affine since $V$ is [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence](1),(2); and $V\times_TT'\to T'$ is etale [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits](1). So the base change functor $b_h:T_{\Et}\to T'_{\Et}$ of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits](1) maps the full subcategory $T_{affine,\Et}$ into $T'_{affine,\Et}$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-topos]; its restriction is the functor $u=u_{i'i}$, resp. $u_i$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EYL (lemma-colimit-affine-sites, line 7336), proof, first paragraph (qcqs case)

proof.text: *Step 2 (continuity).* Keep $h:T'\to T$ and $u$ as in step 1. (a) Let $\{g_j:U_j\to U\}_{j=1,\dots,m}$ be a covering of $T_{affine,\Et}$, a standard etale covering: finitely many affine $U_j$ etale over $U$ with $U=\bigcup_jg_j(U_j)$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-topos]. It is a covering of $T_{\Et}$ (jointly surjective etale family), so $\{u(U_j)\to u(U)\}$ is a covering of $T'_{\Et}$ by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-continuous](1): the morphisms are etale and jointly surjective. The family is finite and its members and target are affine (step 1), so it is a standard etale covering, i.e. a covering of $T'_{affine,\Et}$. (b) For morphisms $U_j\to U\leftarrow W$ of $T_{affine,\Et}$ the scheme-theoretic fibre product $U_j\times_UW$ is affine [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] and etale over $T$, and it is the fibre product in $T_{\Et}$ [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits](2), hence in the full subcategory $T_{affine,\Et}$; the same holds over $T'$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-continuous](2) the canonical morphism $u(U_j\times_UW)\to u(U_j)\times_{u(U)}u(W)$ is an isomorphism. (a) and (b) are the two conditions of continuity [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](3) (Sites, Definition 00WV).

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EYL (lemma-colimit-affine-sites, line 7336), proof, first paragraph (qcqs case); continuity of the base change functors is asserted, not proved, there and in Etale Cohomology Section 03PZ (equation-functorial, line 4430: base change preserves fibre products and coverings, 'easy to check (omitted)')

proof.text: *Step 3 (morphisms of sites).* Keep $h$, $u$. By [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](3) we must show that $u_s$, the left adjoint of $u^s:\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G\circ u$ on sheaves of sets, commutes with finite limits. Let $\rho_T:\mathcal H\mapsto\mathcal H|_{T_{affine,\Et}}$ be the restriction, an equivalence from sheaves of sets on $T_{\Et}$ to sheaves of sets on $T_{affine,\Et}$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-topos], and likewise $\rho_{T'}$. For a sheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $T'_{\Et}$ the direct image is $h_*\mathcal F=\mathcal F\circ b_h$ [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-continuous](3), so for $V$ in $T_{affine,\Et}$, $(\rho_Th_*\mathcal F)(V)=\mathcal F(V\times_TT')=\mathcal F(u(V))=(u^s\rho_{T'}\mathcal F)(V)$, compatibly with restriction maps and naturally in $\mathcal F$: $\rho_T\circ h_*=u^s\circ\rho_{T'}$. The inverse image $h^{-1}$ is left adjoint to $h_*$ and commutes with finite limits [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures](1). Choosing a quasi-inverse $\rho_T^{-1}$, the functor $\rho_{T'}\circ h^{-1}\circ\rho_T^{-1}$ is left adjoint to $\rho_T\circ h_*\circ\rho_{T'}^{-1}\cong u^s$ (an equivalence transports adjunctions), so by uniqueness of left adjoints $u_s\cong\rho_{T'}\circ h^{-1}\circ\rho_T^{-1}$, which commutes with finite limits as a composite of such functors. Hence $u$ defines a morphism of sites.

source.place: Topologies, Lemma Tag 021I (lemma-morphism-big-small-etale (2), topologies.tex line 1175: base change $S_\Et\to T_\Et$ induces the morphism of sites $f_{small}$) and Lemma Tag 04HR (lemma-alternative (topologies.tex line 1005: $S_{affine,\Et}$ and $S_\Et$ have equivalent topoi)); the transfer to the affine sites is not written in the source (Etale Cohomology 0EYL uses it tacitly) and is written here by an agent

proof.text: *Step 4 (composition; the strict system).* For $i\le i'\le i''$ and $V$ in $(X_i)_{affine,\Et}$, the squares $u_{i'i}(V)\to V$ over $f_{i'i}$ and $u_{i''i'}(u_{i'i}V)\to u_{i'i}V$ over $f_{i''i'}$ are cartesian, so by [lem-weil-pbc-cartesian-square-pasting] $(V\times_{X_i}X_{i'})\times_{X_{i'}}X_{i''}$ with its two projections is a fibre product of $V\to X_i$ and $f_{i'i}f_{i''i'}=f_{i''i}$; hence there is a unique isomorphism $\gamma_{i''i'i}(V):u_{i''i'}u_{i'i}(V)\to u_{i''i}(V)$ over $X_{i''}$ compatible with the projections to $V$; in the same way $\delta_{i'i}(V):u_{i'}u_{i'i}(V)\to u_i(V)$ (using $f_i=f_{i'i}f_{i'}$). These are natural in $V$ and are identities when two indices agree (with $u_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$), and the cocycle identities of [lem-weil-pbc-site-system-strictification] hold because both sides are isomorphisms over the last stage compatible with the projections to $V$, and such an isomorphism is unique by the universal property of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. With steps 2 and 3, all hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-site-system-strictification] hold for the sites $(X_i)_{affine,\Et}$ (coverings finite), the functors $u_{i'i}$ and the cone $v_i=u_i$ to $\mathcal D=X_{affine,\Et}$; it gives the sites $\mathcal C_i$, the equivalences $e_i$ and the strict functors $u'_{i'i}$, $u'_i$ of clause (1), and $(\mathcal C_i,u'_{i'i})$ is a system as in [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites]. This proves clause (1).

source.place: Sites, Situation Tag 0A34 (situation-inverse-limit-sites, line 3770) and the proof of Lemma Tag 09YL ('our definition of composition of morphisms of sites implies $u_b\circ u_a=u_c$'); the base change functors satisfy this only up to the canonical isomorphisms, which the source passes over; this step is written by an agent

proof.text: *Step 5 (descent of objects, clause (2)).* Let $U\to X$ be an object of $X_{affine,\Et}$; it is of finite presentation (step 1). By [thm-pd-spreading-out](1) (Limits 01ZM) there are $i\in I$ and a morphism of finite presentation $V_i\to X_i$ with $U\cong V_i\times_{X_i}X$ over $X$. For $i'\ge i$ put $V_{i'}=V_i\times_{X_i}X_{i'}$; by [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-over-limit] $(V_{i'})_{i'\ge i}$ is an inverse system with affine transition morphisms and limit $V_i\times_{X_i}X\cong U$. Each $V_{i'}\to X_{i'}$ is of finite presentation (base change [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](3)), in particular quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and $X_{i'}$ is qcqs, so $V_{i'}$ is qcqs [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](2). As $U$ is affine, [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-stage] (Limits 01Z6) gives $i_1\ge i$ with $V_{i_1}$ affine. Now apply [lem-weil-pbc-descend-etale] (Limits 07RP) to the system $(X_{i'})_{i'\ge i_1}$ and $f_0:V_{i_1}\to X_{i_1}$ over $S_0=Y_0=X_{i_1}$ (all qcqs): its base change to $X$ is $U\to X$ (up to the isomorphism above, by [lem-weil-pbc-cartesian-square-pasting]: $V_{i_1}\times_{X_{i_1}}X\cong V_i\times_{X_i}X$), which is etale, and $f_0$ is locally of finite presentation; so for some $i_2\ge i_1$ the base change $U_{i_2}:=V_{i_1}\times_{X_{i_1}}X_{i_2}\to X_{i_2}$ is etale. $U_{i_2}$ is affine, being affine over the affine $V_{i_1}$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence](1),(2). So $U_{i_2}$ is an object of $(X_{i_2})_{affine,\Et}$ and $u_{i_2}(U_{i_2})=U_{i_2}\times_{X_{i_2}}X\cong V_{i_1}\times_{X_{i_1}}X\cong U$ over $X$ ([lem-weil-pbc-cartesian-square-pasting]).

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EYL (lemma-colimit-affine-sites, line 7336), proof, first paragraph (qcqs case): 'the category of schemes of finite presentation over $X$ is the colimit ... (Limits 01ZM). The same holds for the subcategories of affine objects etale over $X$ by Limits, Lemmas 01Z6 and 07RP'; the system $V_{i'}$ is that of the second paragraph ($U=\lim_{i'\ge i}U_{i'}$, Limits 01YZ)

proof.text: *Step 6 (descent of morphisms and of their equality, clause (3)).* Let $U_i$, $V_i$ be objects of $(X_i)_{affine,\Et}$; they are of finite presentation over $X_i$ (step 1). A morphism $\varphi:u_i(U_i)=U_i\times_{X_i}X\to V_i\times_{X_i}X=u_i(V_i)$ over $X$ is, by [thm-pd-spreading-out](2), the base change of a morphism $\varphi_{i'}:U_i\times_{X_i}X_{i'}\to V_i\times_{X_i}X_{i'}$ over $X_{i'}$ for some $i'\ge i$; $\varphi_{i'}$ is a morphism of $(X_{i'})_{affine,\Et}$ (a full subcategory of the schemes over $X_{i'}$) from $u_{i'i}(U_i)$ to $u_{i'i}(V_i)$, and its base change to $X$ is $u_{i'}(\varphi_{i'})$ composed with the isomorphisms $\delta_{i'i}$ of step 4. If $\varphi,\psi:U_i\to V_i$ are morphisms over $X_i$ with $u_i(\varphi)=u_i(\psi)$, then [thm-pd-spreading-out](3) gives $i'\ge i$ with $u_{i'i}(\varphi)=u_{i'i}(\psi)$. Objects or morphisms given at two indices are first moved to a common larger index ($I$ directed) by the $u_{i'i}$ and the isomorphisms $\gamma$ of step 4.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EYL (lemma-colimit-affine-sites, line 7336), proof, first paragraph (qcqs case) ('the category of schemes of finite presentation over $X$ is the colimit of the categories of schemes of finite presentation over $X_i$, see Limits 01ZM'), and second paragraph ('Fully faithfulness follows directly from ... Limits 0EY1')

proof.text: *Step 7 (coverings, clause (4)).* Images of coverings are coverings: $u_i$ is continuous (step 2). Conversely let $\{g^j:U^j\to U\}_{j=1,\dots,m}$ be a covering of $X_{affine,\Et}$. By steps 5 and 6 applied to the finitely many objects and morphisms, and $I$ being directed, there are $i$, objects $U_i$, $U_i^j$ of $(X_i)_{affine,\Et}$, morphisms $g_i^j:U_i^j\to U_i$ over $X_i$ and isomorphisms $u_i(U_i)\cong U$, $u_i(U_i^j)\cong U^j$ over $X$ under which $u_i(g_i^j)$ corresponds to $g^j$. Put $W_i=\coprod_jU_i^j$, affine [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence](4), and $G_i=(g_i^j)_j:W_i\to U_i$, a morphism over $X_i$ which is etale on each open and closed piece $U_i^j$ ([lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation](3)), hence locally of finite presentation. For $i'\ge i$ (resp. at the limit) the base change of $G_i$ is the morphism $\coprod_ju_{i'i}(U_i^j)\to u_{i'i}(U_i)$ (resp. $\coprod_ju_i(U_i^j)\to u_i(U_i)$) induced by the $u_{i'i}(g_i^j)$ (resp. $u_i(g^j_i)$), since the base change of the open covering $\{U_i^j\}$ of $W_i$ is an open covering of the base change by pieces $U^j_i\times_{X_i}X_{i'}$; so its image is the union of the images of the $u_{i'i}(g_i^j)$. At the limit this union is $U$, the $g^j$ being jointly surjective; so the base change of $G_i$ to $X$ is surjective. $X_i$, $W_i$, $U_i$ are qcqs (affine), so [lem-weil-pbc-descend-surjective] (Limits 07RR), applied with $S_0=X_i$, $X_0=W_i$, $Y_0=U_i$, gives $i'\ge i$ with the base change of $G_i$ to $X_{i'}$ surjective, i.e. $\{u_{i'i}(g_i^j)\}_j$ jointly surjective: a standard etale covering of $(X_{i'})_{affine,\Et}$ (step 1 for affineness and etaleness), whose image under $u_{i'}$ is isomorphic, via the isomorphisms $\delta_{i'i}$ of step 4 and those chosen above, to $\{g^j:U^j\to U\}$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EYL (lemma-colimit-affine-sites, line 7336), proof, first paragraph (qcqs case): 'if $\{U^j\to U\}$ is a covering of $X_{affine,\Et}$ and if $U_i^j\to U_i$ is morphism of affine schemes etale over $X_i$ whose base change to $X$ is $U^j\to U$, then we see that the base change of $\{U_i^j\to U_i\}$ to some $X_{i'}$ is a covering for $i'$ large enough, see Limits, Lemma 07RR'; the passage to the disjoint union, needed to apply 07RR to a family, is written out here

proof.text: *Step 8 (assembling, clause (5)).* Let $\mathcal C=\varinjlim_i\mathcal C_i$ be the colimit site of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites] for the strict system of step 4, with canonical functors $c_i:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal C$, and $\Phi:\mathcal C\to X_{affine,\Et}$ the functor induced by the $u'_i$ ($u'_{i'}u'_{i'i}=u'_i$, so they form a cocone on the objects and on the arrows, filtered colimits of sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]). Every object of $\mathcal C$ is $c_i(A)$ with $A\cong e_i(A_0)$, and $\Phi c_i(A)\cong u_i(A_0)$. $\Phi$ is essentially surjective by step 5. For objects $c_i(A),c_i(B)$ (two objects of $\mathcal C$ come from a common $i$) the arrows between them in $\mathcal C$ are $\varinjlim_{i'\ge i}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C_{i'}}(u'_{i'i}A,u'_{i'i}B)\cong\varinjlim_{i'\ge i}\operatorname{Hom}(u_{i'i}A_0,u_{i'i}B_0)$ (the $e_{i'}$ are fully faithful and $u'_{i'i}e_i\cong e_{i'}u_{i'i}$), and $\Phi$ maps this to $\operatorname{Hom}_X(u_iA_0,u_iB_0)$ by the base change maps; this is surjective and injective by step 6, so $\Phi$ is fully faithful, hence an equivalence. A family in $\mathcal C$ is a covering iff it is $c_i$ of a covering of some $\mathcal C_i$, iff (via $e_i$, which preserves and reflects coverings up to isomorphism) it is isomorphic to the image of a standard etale covering of some $(X_i)_{affine,\Et}$; by step 7 (and since a family isomorphic to a standard etale covering is one) this holds iff its image under $\Phi$ is a covering of $X_{affine,\Et}$. So $\Phi$ identifies the colimit site with $X_{affine,\Et}$, which is clause (5).

split_report.summary: Split along the first paragraph of the Stacks proof of 0EYL (qcqs case); the statement is restricted to qcqs X_i, as the source does first and as all users (lem-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-limit-of-schemes, step 3, with affine X_i) need, and made explicit in five clauses. Steps: (1) the schemes are qcqs and the objects of the affine sites are of finite presentation, base change preserves affine etale objects; (2) continuity from the reviewed lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-continuous; (3) morphisms of sites by transporting h^{-1} (finite-limit preserving, reviewed nodes) along the equivalences of lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-topos, an argument the source leaves tacit; (4) the canonical isomorphisms of iterated fibre products and a new strictification node, since Situation 0A34 needs u_b u_a = u_c exactly and base change is only pseudo-functorial (the source passes over this); (5) objects by 01ZM(1) (cited through thm-pd-spreading-out), 01YZ, 01Z6 (Mathlib leaf) and 07RP; (6) morphisms by 01ZM(2),(3); (7) coverings by 07RR applied to the finite disjoint union; (8) the comparison functor from the colimit site of lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites. New nodes: lem-weil-pbc-scheme-over-limit (01YZ), lem-weil-pbc-descend-etale (07RP), lem-weil-pbc-descend-surjective (07RR), lem-weil-pbc-site-system-strictification (unsplit); lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-stage (01Z6), lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence, lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence (Mathlib leaves).
